json_ld.description: Bring colour and character to the page with the Ferris Wheel Press Masque Fountain Pen & Ink Charger Set, created exclusively for Barnes & Noble. This light blue resin fountain pen pairs polished brass details with a contoured engraved brass grip, giving the pen a balanced, comfortable feel in hand.    A smooth-writing No. 6 steel nib with 24K gold plating delivers a controlled 0.55mm medium line, while the precision-engineered cap seal helps maintain a generous ink flow. A standard international converter makes filling from bottled ink simple, while the interchangeable nib housing lets the Masque grow with your writing style.    Three 10ml ink pots complete the set: warm mid-grey Leadcast Letters, midnight blue Stroke of Midnight with red sheen and mixed metallic shimmer, and blue-green Edwards Gardens with red sheen and gold shimmer. Together, these three shades bring understated neutrals, dramatic colour, and luminous detail to the page."
